statement: Unrestricted generic complementary affine linear sections of St(2,3) have monodromy S_8.

source.location: Proposition 1.1; family-result Bertini reduction; Brysiewicz–Gesmundo Lemma 2.4 and Table 1

origin.inheritance_basis: Explicit specialization k=2, n=3, degree=8; k<n.

notes:
Explicit deduction from the irreducible-variety sectional-monodromy theorem and the recorded degree. It applies because k<n. The disconnected orthogonal case k=n is excluded.

LMFDB identification: 8T50 in the recorded permutation degree. Standard generating permutations, when newly supplied here, are an abstract relabeling of the proved group action; they are not additional path-tracking data.

This is a catalogue application of the classical characteristic-zero sectional-monodromy theorem, called folklore in Kadets, Proposition 1.1. Kadets is cited for an explicit proof, not as the originator of that theorem; the stated Bertini reduction identifies the particular enumerative family.
